const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root = Path('.')
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w33-20260926'
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
before = loader.load_path(task / 'baseline/tome-cults.lua', logical_path='tome-cults.lua').records
after = loader.load_path(root / 'tome-cults.lua', logical_path='tome-cults.lua').records
work = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
allowed = {(i['section'], i['source'], i['source_tag']): i for i in work}
assert len(work) == len(allowed) == 21
assert len(before) == len(after), (len(before), len(after))
changed = []
for old, new in zip(before, after):
    old_n = {k: v for k, v in old.items() if k != 'line'}
    new_n = {k: v for k, v in new.items() if k != 'line'}
    if old_n == new_n:
        continue
    key = (old.get('section'), old.get('source'), old.get('source_tag'))
    assert key in allowed, ('out-of-scope', key)
    assert old.get('target') == allowed[key]['target_preimage'], ('baseline-preimage', key)
    assert {k: v for k, v in old_n.items() if k != 'target'} == {k: v for k, v in new_n.items() if k != 'target'}, ('non-target-field-drift', key)
    assert old['target'].count('\n') == new['target'].count('\n'), ('lf-drift', key)
    assert [len(x) - len(x.lstrip('\t')) for x in old['target'].split('\n')] == [len(x) - len(x.lstrip('\t')) for x in new['target'].split('\n')], ('tab-drift', key)
    changed.append(allowed[key]['entry_revision_identity'])
assert len(changed) == 21, len(changed)
assert set(changed) == {i['entry_revision_identity'] for i in work}
rows = {(r.get('section'), r.get('source'), r.get('source_tag')): r for r in after if r.get('kind') == 'translation'}
item = next(i for i in work if i['entry_revision_identity'].startswith('4ad18d30bc'))
target = rows[(item['section'], item['source'], item['source_tag'])]['target']
assert '我只知道我已怒不可遏。' in target
assert '当然，你看起来比大多数人都更坚韧。' in target
assert '我只知道我脸色发青。' not in target
assert '当然，你看起来比其他人都要更加顽固。' not in target
print(json.dumps({'verified': True, 'runtime': 'LocaleLoader via LuaJIT', 'baseline_records': len(before), 'current_records': len(after), 'changed_targets': 21, 'workset_exact_match': True, 'non_target_field_changes': 0, 'lf_tab_drift': 0, 'confirmed_target_present': '4ad18d30bc'}, ensure_ascii=False))

from pathlib import Path
import json, sys

from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root = Path('.')
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w33-20260926'
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
before = loader.load_path(task / 'baseline/tome-cults.lua', logical_path='tome-cults.lua').records
after = loader.load_path(root / 'tome-cults.lua', logical_path='tome-cults.lua').records
work = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
allowed = {(i['section'], i['source'], i['source_tag']): i for i in work}
assert len(work) == len(allowed) == 21
assert len(before) == len(after), (len(before), len(after))
changed = []
changed_rows = {}
for old, new in zip(before, after):
    old_n = {k: v for k, v in old.items() if k != 'line'}
    new_n = {k: v for k, v in new.items() if k != 'line'}
    if old_n == new_n:
        continue
    key = (old.get('section'), old.get('source'), old.get('source_tag'))
